scope: PTT Stock public posts/replies captured under D20 social source contract

topicLabels.ETF: explicit ETF/0050/正二 or broad index-product references
topicLabels.LEVERAGE: explicit 質押/借款/槓桿 references
topicLabels.MARKET_OUTLOOK: explicit 大盤/Q4/多頭/空頭 market-outlook language

stanceRules.BULLISH: explicit 看多/多頭/會漲/上看 equivalent without explicit bearish contradiction
stanceRules.BEARISH: explicit 看空/空頭/會跌/下看 equivalent without explicit bullish contradiction
stanceRules.MIXED_BULLISH_UNCERTAIN: explicit bullish market/stock direction plus explicit uncertainty such as 不知道是否正確/猶豫/不確定
stanceRules.MIXED_BEARISH_UNCERTAIN: explicit bearish direction plus explicit uncertainty

reactionGuard: push/boo/arrow is never mapped directly to stock stance
privacyGuard: No named-user psychology/influence profile. Handles, when source-exposed, may be used transiently only for within-window distinct-participant deduplication.
